description: Shared runtime dependency contract for SocialFlow product-scoped preview. Defines which cross-product modules are allowed and under what constraints.

sharedRuntimeDependencies.reason: Contains cookie configurations for ALL products (drakos, mentorias, socialflow, bases). SocialFlow only uses socialflow config at runtime.
forbiddenBehaviors: Must not issue Drako/Bases/Mentoria cookies from SocialFlow routes
Must not resolve foreign tenant sessions
Must not access foreign auth state
requiredEvidence: Route uses SocialFlow auth context only
No foreign context resolution in execution path
mitigations: Cookie config lookup scoped to 'socialflow' context

sharedRuntimeDependencies.reason: Provides clearAuthsSessionCookie() and jsonError() helpers. Scoped by context parameter.
foreignTokens: Generic auth helpers used by all products
forbiddenBehaviors: Must not clear foreign product cookies
Must not leak session tokens across products
requiredEvidence: No foreign context passed to helpers
mitigations: Cookie config lookup scoped by context

sharedRuntimeDependencies.reason: Provides enforceAuthBoundary() which validates product isolation. Critical for security.
foreignTokens: Auth context definitions for all products

sharedRuntimeDependencies.reason: Resolves auth context from request. Contains logic for all products.
foreignTokens: Context resolution for drakos, mentorias, bases
forbiddenBehaviors: Must not resolve to foreign context from SocialFlow routes
Must not leak foreign routing logic

sharedRuntimeDependencies.reason: Unified DRACO_DB access layer. All products share same D1 database with tenant_id isolation.
foreignTokens: Database access used by all products
forbiddenBehaviors: Must not query foreign tenant data
Must not access cross-product tables without tenant_id

sharedRuntimeDependencies.reason: Generic HTTP error response helpers. No product-specific logic.
Reusable settings UI components. May contain references to other products in shared chunks.
foreignTokens: UI component code shared across products
forbiddenBehaviors: Must not execute foreign product logic
Must not access foreign product state
requiredEvidence: Props scoped to SocialFlow data only
No foreign API calls from component

undeclaredDependencies.reason: Any shared dependency not in this contract must be explicitly reviewed and approved.
